name: Squat to Calf Raise
description: A squat that finishes on your toes: sit your hips back into a comfortable squat, stand up through your heels, then rise onto the balls of your feet.

source.title: Squat to Calf Raise tutorial (Runna)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with your feet hip- to shoulder-width apart.
cues: Push your hips back and keep your chest up in the squat.
Stand up through your heels, then roll up onto your toes.
Lower your heels with control before the next rep.

prescription.note: Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Squat
keyframes.cue: Sit your hips back and down.

keyframes.name: Calf raise
keyframes.cue: Rise onto the balls of your feet.
